Fix broken link to RBI Grade B Practice Set 12
fixes.detail: Browser test identified a broken link on the Homepage pointing to 'rbi/papers/practice-set-12.html' which returns a 404 or invalid path.
fixes.text: Locate the HTML source of the homepage, find the anchor tag containing 'practice-set-12', and update its href to point to a valid existing file in the data/ directory (e.g., rename or create a matching practice set) or remove it if no equivalent exists.

fixes.detail: Currently only two exam sets (ssc-je, ssc-je-production) are available for single-click practice, limiting utility for users seeking other topics.
fixes.text: Modify the daily-wiki-fill or agent workflow to automatically generate new practice set JSON files for high-frequency topics found in the 'Invented' pool and add them to the single-click selection list.

fixes.fix: Improve Tutor Questions Lane Output Parsing
fixes.detail: Recent failures show the tutor lane sometimes returns non-JSON text or insufficient question counts (e.g., only 2 of 5 valid questions), causing partial results.
fixes.text: Update the Node.js script in the GitHub Actions workflow to use a more robust regex-based parser that extracts JSON arrays from free-form LLM output and retries generation if the count is below the threshold.

fixes.fix: Add 'Next' Button Visibility Check to Homepage
fixes.detail: Browser tests flagged 'flow-skipped on Homepage' due to a missing visible Next button, preventing users from exercising the quiz flow immediately upon load.
fixes.text: Inspect the homepage HTML structure for the quiz container and ensure the 'Next' button is rendered inside the main content area with valid accessibility attributes (aria-label) so it is not skipped by assistive technologies or screen readers.
